sources.prompt: You run headless on pi: there is no WebFetch/WebSearch tool — fetch pages with bash: curl -sL <url> (arxiv abs/html pages, huggingface model pages, github READMEs via raw.githubusercontent.com) and strip tags with python3. Quote URL + date for every claim; mark MEASURED vs ESTIMATE. Write your full digest to /home/ubuntu/work/agi/.agi/context/local-maxxing/troves/2026-09-16-oscillatory/<your key>.md (one file, markdown, sections: Sources read / Mechanisms / Numbers / Code availability / Fit on our iron (A1 4-core CPU 23 GB; local-town gpu-8g + 15 GB RAM; Camber XS 24 GB, 3 GPU-hours per MONTH) / How it maps to the owner sketch / What to try first at $0). OWNER SKETCH to map every finding onto (verbatim gist): a hybrid timeless/timeful architecture — an ordinary LLM does next-token matrix computation; a sparse SPIKING OSCILLATOR network constantly reads the LLM's KV caches and head activations as on/off bit triggers; each oscillator's frequency is both a measure of system energy and its predicted value; ENERGY = ALIGNMENT (aligned frequencies propagate cheaply, misaligned ones cost energy to align via selective subscription of downstream neurons); each neuron subscribes to only 10-200 READ SITES and the subscription set IS the weight, plus one weight per source clamped between two non-zero positive/negative bands; frequency bands are held by subscribing to a small RHYTHM-NEURON subnetwork (a metronome offering steady tones), not per-neuron clocks; frequency quantisation should EMERGE from the energy mechanics; no strict layer hierarchy; an oscillator steady state that shifts as sentence meaning evolves. The owner's stated priority: make the internal metronome oscillation system WORK. HUNT: prediction-based, energy-based and frequency-based oscillatory neural models. Start from: Artificial Kuramoto Oscillatory Neurons (AKOrN, Miyato et al., arXiv 2410.13821), oscillatory state-space models (LinOSS, arXiv 2410.03943; D-LinOSS), Energy-Based Transformers (arXiv 2507.02092) and energy-based models generally, predictive coding networks (Rao-Ballard lineage; 'predictive coding' + transformers 2023-2026), modern Hopfield / dense associative memory (Ramsauer 2020; Krotov), spiking transformers (Spikformer, SpikeGPT, Spike-driven Transformer v1-v3), resonate-and-fire and adaptive-frequency neurons, central pattern generators / rhythm-generating subnetworks, binding-by-synchrony and phase-coding papers. For EACH: the mechanism in two lines, what it measures and the headline number, code + licence, CPU-toy feasibility (numpy, minutes), and the ONE line that maps it to the sketch (which of: subscription-as-weight, rhythm subnetwork, energy=alignment, emergent frequency quantisation, KV/head-bit readout). End with the 3 papers whose mechanism is closest to the metronome idea and the smallest numpy experiment that would test it.

AWQ? GPTQ of LLaDA/Dream) and llama.cpp / vLLM support status for dLLMs. For each: parameters, open weights + licence, published tok/s and hardware, quantisation state, what an oscillator net could READ at each denoising step (logits, confidence/entropy per position, unmasking order) and what it could GATE (which positions to unmask, when to stop) — a denoising step is a natural timeful state update. Fit on our iron with numbers. End with: the ONE open dLLM we could run on local-town 8 GB or Camber XS 24 GB, and the ONE hybrid experiment (oscillators reading per-step confidences to schedule unmasking) that costs $0 beyond the model download.

angles.text: The smallest experiment that shows the metronome mechanism WORKS: a numpy toy on the A1 (minutes, $0) with a rhythm-neuron subnetwork, 10-200 subscribed read sites per neuron as the weight, clamped non-zero +/- source weights, energy = alignment cost; measurements that decide it (frequency histogram quantisation, energy per step vs alignment, state-shift latency when driving bits change); build on the town's existing C2 digital-Kuramoto flip toy (hypothesis:c2-digital-kuramoto-flip-mode). Write it as hypothesis nodes: claim, falsifier, numbers, ceiling.

Where the oscillator net READS bits from a model and what it GATES: AR LLM (KV cache, head activations, logit entropy per token) vs diffusion LLM (per-step confidences, unmasking order) — which is the easier hybrid, what the first $0 experiment is on the 9B already served on local-town (llama.cpp hooks that expose activations) or on an open dLLM, and the falsifier for 'the steady state shifts with sentence meaning'.

Fit + cost table for everything the three readers found on our iron: A1 4-core CPU 23 GB RAM; local-town gpu-8g + 15 GB RAM; Camber XS 24 GB at 3 GPU-hours/MONTH. Name what runs where, at what tok/s (MEASURED vs ESTIMATE), what needs a download (GB) and what needs GPU hours (minutes) — and rank by knowledge-per-token: cheap, decisive, informative-when-failing first.
